text: I. Professional Positioning and Disciplinary ConnotationEnvironmental science and engineering is an interdisciplinary subject that integrates natural science, engineering technology and social science, with the core goal of "solving environmental pollution problems and achieving harmonious development between humans and nature". Its research scope covers the entire chain from environmental pollution mechanisms (such as the formation mechanism of atmospheric PM2.5 and the principle of water eutrophication) to pollution control technologies (such as wastewater treatment processes and the resource utilization of solid waste), and then to environmental policy formulation (such as carbon emission trading systems and environmental protection regulations), possessing both theoretical depth and practical value.1. Knowledge module divisionFundamentals of Environmental Science: It studies the essence of environmental issues, including environmental chemistry (the migration and transformation of pollutants in the environment), environmental ecology (the interaction between ecosystems and human activities), environmental geoscience (the connection between geology and environmental pollution), etc.Environmental engineering technology: Focusing on engineering practices for pollution control, such as water pollution control engineering (sewage treatment plant design), air pollution control engineering (desulfurization and denitrification technology), solid waste treatment (waste incineration and resource utilization), etc.Environmental management and policy: It involves environmental impact assessment (EIA), environmental planning, environmental economics (cost-benefit analysis of pollution control), environmental regulations (such as the Environmental Protection Law and the Law on the Prevention and Control of Atmospheric Pollution), etc.
